1.why: I dislike math but have studied it. I can do basic tasks, so I don't completely lack confidence in my abilities.

2.why: I am not naturally gifted at math but can still learn and perform with effort and study time.

3.why: I think I could learn well if given the right resources and support from instructors during the course.

4.why: I worry about future courses because of my history of anxiety and dislike for technical subjects like this.

5.why: I believe I can understand the content, though it sometimes requires extra time to process complex ideas.

6.why: Getting an A is very difficult for me due to my low confidence and high nervousness during exams.

7.why: I often struggle with actual problems and feel overwhelmed by the technical aspects of mathematics courses.

8.why: I am very worried about test performance because I fear making mistakes and not knowing enough material.

9.why: Preparing for tests makes me tense and anxious, which affects my ability to study effectively and relax.

10.why: Taking math tests causes severe nervousness and anxiety that can make me unable to focus on questions.

11.why: Getting an A feels impossible because I worry too much about performance and making mistakes in exams.

12.why: I am anxious about getting a good grade and fear that my anxiety will negatively impact my results.

13.why: I cannot feel confident when taking tests due to high neuroticism and fear of poor performance outcomes.

14.why: I doubt I can do well on tests because of my dislike for math and history of poor academic experiences.

15.why: Homework is somewhat stressful but not as much as exams, though I still find it challenging to complete.

16.why: Using math outside school makes me slightly nervous since I prefer creative activities like art over technical ones.

17.why: I feel very unconfident using mathematics outside of school settings where I have no support or practice.

18.why: I worry about applying math in my future career, but I am currently unemployed so this is theoretical stress.

19.why: Understanding math concepts can be difficult for me and sometimes makes me worry about not grasping ideas.

20.why: I think I could learn well with effort though my general anxiety levels make it more challenging than others.

21.why: Listening to math instructors is somewhat stressful but not overwhelming, especially when topics interest me like biology.
